title: Distribution of composed verifier seeds
statement: Let $n>0$, let $V$ be a Boolean proof-checking system with input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and query count $r$, and let a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ use parameter $K$. The seed distribution of the composed verifier is the distribution obtained by first sampling a seed from $V$'s verifier distribution and then sampling a clause index uniformly from the reduction's $K$ clauses for that seed; the resulting seed is the pair consisting of the sampled verifier seed and clause index.
